title: Complete-stream decompression of the LP2 number grid
question: Do the printed number-grid bytes form a complete raw DEFLATE, zlib, gzip, bzip2 or LZMA stream in any of four fixed routes?
reader_question: Does the number grid decompress as a complete stream?
summary: Exact Wulfic Stage X4 component replay and an independent checker find no end-of-stream across five decoders and four full-grid routes.
finding: Zero of 20 complete-grid decoder calls reaches EOF. All 24 pinned X4 rows reproduce exactly, including four absent offset-zero signature rows. The source's 100,000-block calibration yielded 552 raw-DEFLATE EOFs and zero observed for each other decoder; independent recomputation matches. Synthetic complete/truncated/trailing-junk controls pass as separately labeled post-replay diagnostics.
limitations: Only 256 exact printed-grid bytes, four source routes, five decoder APIs, offset zero, a single call and 1 MiB output cap. Source EOF does not require consuming all input; zero calibration hits is finite-sample evidence, not a true zero rate. Other byte constructions, offsets, keys, formats and larger outputs remain untested.
next_steps: A compression proposal should specify the grid bytes, route, exact codec and any pre-transform before testing, then validate a complete output and trailing-input rule.

scope.representation: The 256 printed base-60 grid cells parsed to bytes in row/reversed-row/column/reversed-column order.
scope.procedure: Replay the pinned Stage X4 component with 100,000 seeded uniform-byte calibration blocks for each decoder. Test each complete grid route with raw DEFLATE, zlib, gzip, bzip2 and LZMA; also preserve Stage N offset-zero signature rows. Independently reconstruct the grid and every decoder result.
scope.parameters: Five source decoders × four routes = 20 complete-stream calls, plus four signature checks. One bounded call per decoder with 1 MiB output cap; source PASS requires EOF and empirical null rate ×20≤0.01.
scope.exclusions: Nonzero offsets, prefixes, modified grid cells, keys or other transformations, other compression formats, full-input-consumption requirement and larger decompressed outputs.

review.kind: exact public-source Stage X4 component replay with independent decoder and null checks
review.reviewer: All 24 X4 rows matched pinned Stage X result subset; site grid rebuilt independently and all 500,000 decoder-calibration calls reproduced; later synthetic controls explicitly separated

reproduction.environment: Python 3 standard library and NumPy. Optional external-source replay requires the pinned Wulfic checkout.

visuals.caption: Five complete-stream decoders on four fixed grid routes. No call reaches decoder EOF; random raw DEFLATE can reach EOF and is calibrated separately.
